tei:div.tei:p: bde mad+kunamamakha' dang mkhopa'i m+mu kyirtsa 'a྾/mardzo smi mdzad pa po ri ོོsri mkhan pha dkan mchag rgyal mar+sā/spar skyan zhug ོ seri'i'i 0na 'as ṅga shālha/zhusgrag r+pā 'amakhan bshad sgrugabastan 'dzan/nga thengs dang po phyilo 2cud+ku degagrangs 77'anyasayul rgyal sa ldil+li nas par bskya zhus galags so//

dkar chag she/ bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i dum bu ste le'u dang po 1she/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i dum bu ste le'u gnyis pa 5she) las sna tshogs kyi dum bu ste le'u gsum pa tu4na/ rgyud kyi don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le las/mchod par brjod pa sogs 11) gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa'i skor 12tu/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i skor 14gyi/ rgyud dngos bshad pa 15pye/ le'u dang po'i rnam bshad/ lus rnam par dag pa bskyed rim bstan pa 26she) le'u gnyis pa'i rnam bshad/ sems rnam par dag pa rdzogs rim 4byu bstan pa sti1ge/ le'u gsum pa'i rnam bshad/ ngag rnam par dag pa sngags kyi rim pa bstan pa 40

byung//daswāl ba~X mchog༄ sna mkha' dang mnyam pa' rgyud rgyal pa zhas bya ba bzhugs//ra༅༅/ /rgya gar3dadu/shrīsaṃ b.rakhas ma ṭ+wāṃn+d+ra rā~X ོ༵/zlo skad du/dpal bad ༷/dz+nyo naX mkha' dang mnyam pañcha da ོ sdu sa bya ba/k+tajazidapal sdu samasaduga' laphyaga'arilasna/ga//daskad bdag sa ṭ+wāṃs pa dus gcig na/bcaspya ldan kādaX ༷ ban gas pa skyas rdad skyu rnyi kār+sha dang thugs rda rja bkyirnyi marnyi bha ga la zlozhurngisdu snru/n+d+ra/ nas ) ban rigardzu pa thams cad na rlabs sa sdo rja nga pas gsal pa/ rikya rdzudrom ldan 'dakyi/gsan+d+rab bsakyang ༵sa gsang ba/gsang ba chan pa da bshad du gsal/bcam ldan 'das sa bka' a+yo pa/ོrisnyi+o+o+o'ikau nga pa khyaX nyaX cag/srag dang lnga padadzona~X/ོ/ོrisnyi+o ༷༷didang 'brardzu bu nyad na no// ོrda rja nga pas gsal pa/bcam ldan 'das srag gang lags/bcam

2 bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud ldan 'das kyis bka' sum pa/ srog ni 'dzin par byed pa ste/ /sngags dang rlung dang rten nyid do/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das lnga pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sugo pa/sangs rgyas lnga dang 'byung ba lnga/ /lnga pa yang ni gcig nyid do/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das lam gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'o/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das smin pa'i lam ni gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/bum pa gsang ba shes rab dang / /bzhi pa'i rang bzhin ngo bo ste/ /de yi rnam pa de la gnas/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das grol ba'i lam ni ga/nga lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ snying rje chen po las skyes pa/ /

bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud 3dga' ba'i dza/gas las rnam par grub/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med mchosgog /bde ba chen po'i lam yin no/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das snying rje chen po ni gang /dga' ba ni gang / thabs ni gang / shes rab ni gang / gnyis su med pa ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sum pa/dmigs pa med pa snying rje'i mchog /dga' ba gnyis med bde ba che/ /thabs ni he ru ka dpal nyid/ /shes rab rdo rje rnal 'gror ma/ / gnyis su med pa zung 'jug mchog /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das he ru ka ni gang lags/ rnal 'gyor ma ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/he ru ka ni phung po nyid/ /phung po yang ni he ru ka /khams ni rdo rje ma dpal te/ /rdo rje ma dpal khams nyid do/ /skye mched de yang de bzhin du/ /

4 bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud lha yi ngo bor shes par bya/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das phung po'i he ru ka gang lags/khams kyi rdo rje rnal 'gror ma gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 355 pa/he ru ka dpal bdag nyid dngos/ /dri ma med pa'i kha dog can/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa ste/ /drug gis brgyan cing dgu dang ldan/ /zla tshes sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /rigs kyi bdag pos rnam par brgyan/ /spyan gsum dag gis mdzes pa ste/ /chags pa med pa'i sham thabs can/ /shes rab rang bzhin rnal 'byor ma / /ban+d+ra dmar po'i kha dog can/ /gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing / /dag pa lnga bcu'i phreng bas mdzes/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i snod bsnams pa/ /yab la 'khyud cing brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /

bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud 5gnyis med bde ba la dgyes pa/ /chu skyes nyi ma'i dbus na 'gying / /khams nyid kyang ni lha nyid do/ /dpal bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i dum bu ste le'u dang po'o// //rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ni gang lags/ ngo bo nyid kyis 'od gsal ba ni gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/brtan dang ga〈sna ba thams cad kun/ /shes rab rang bzhin ma nyid de/ /lnga pa'i ngo bo 'od gsal nyid/ /ma skyes rtog pa bral ba'i sku/ /brjod du med cing bsam mi khyab/ /rtog pa med pa nam mkha'i dbus/ /gnyis med bde ba'i rnam pa can/ /gsal ba'i rang bzhin g.yo ba med/ /gnyis su med pa bde ba'i mchog /'bras bu lam gyi rnam pa'o/ /

6 bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud dpal bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i dum bu ste le'u gnyis pa'o// //rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par rtog pa rnam par dag pa ni gang lags/ bcerdzom ldan 'das kyis bka' sum pa/sngags dang sbyin sreg gtor ma dang / /dbang gi rnam par dag pa dang / /maṇ+ḍal dang ni de bzhin du/ /bum pa'i ngo so lhar shes pa/ /sngags kyi de bzhin gnas pa'o/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sngags ni gang / sbyin sreg ni gang / gtor ma ni gang / dbang ni gang / maṇ+ḍal ni gang / bum pa ni gang / sngags kyi de bzhin nyid ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' rgyujil pa/sngags ni gsang sngags rgyal po ste/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kai hūm̐ sh+lau phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dz+wa la sasba ra swāhā/ oṃ hrīḥ ha ha ghu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sar+bha lhu ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇaṇanī ye hūm̐ lhu phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ lhu phaṭa swā hā/gsang sngags rgyal po 'di dag gis/ /

bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud 7bskal pa stostong la serdzogs pa yi/ /sdig pa ma lus dag byed chu/ /gru bzhi pa la 〉sna bzhi pa/ /'khor lo dag gis rnam par mdzes a shwat+tha dang n+ya gro da/ /dūr ba la sku1gas de bzhin du/ /bzhi pa'i ngo bor yang dag shes/ /sha lnga dang ni bdud rtsi lnga/ / cen du glu gyi sgra bsgrags pas/ /dpa' bo rnal 'gror ma kun dgyes/ /dbang ni tha ma'i lam nyid do / /bdud rtsi chu yis legs byugs nas/ /me tog dmar yos mchod pa 'o/ /rin chen snod bzang zlo gyis mdzes/ /dpa' bo bdud rtsi dargo byed chu/ /zhal bzhi'i sngags kyi 'od zer gyis/ /gdug pa ma lus kun 'dul zhing / /spro dang bsdu ba'i rnam pa can/ /

8 bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ kye bcom ldan 'das skye mched kyi mkha' 'gro ma gang lags/ bcemam ldan 'das kyis bka' rgyuyil pa/ gcer bu thal ba'i mdog can te/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul rnams 'grim/ /lnga pa dang ni drug pa 'o/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sngags ni gang / gtor ma ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' rgyu'il pa/oṃ dz+wa la mu khri ḍā ki nī kai ka ni sh+lau phaṭa/ oṃ pa ri nā ya ni ḍā ki nī lha phaṭa/ tshosna ma ḍi ra ḍā ki nī hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshusgo pa ra mu khri ḍā ki nī hūm̐ phaṭa/ 61 u lu ka ti ḍā ki nī ṇ+ḍaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a ra ṇa ma ṇi ḍā ki nī sh+lau phaṭa/chu skyes dag gis rnam brgyan cing / /bdud rtsi lnga yis rnam par mdzes/ /dpa' resna drug ni mnyes par 'gyur/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das smin pa'i lam ni gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/bzhi pa'i rang bzhin ngo so ste/ /de yi rnam pa de la gnas/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam pa'i ngo bo ni gang / sprul

bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud 9pa'i ngo bo ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rnam pa'i ngo bo lha nyid de / /sprul pa tshogs kyi bdag por bshad/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das tshogs kyi bdag po ni gang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dbang gi kha dog dmar po ste/ /zhal bsangeg pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /sprul pa 'khor lo'i rtsibs la gnas/ /brkyang bskum tshul gyis mnan pa'o/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bsnyen par bya ba gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/bsnyen par bya ba sngags nyid de/ /snyed ga ṇa pa ta ye swā hā/nag po 'bru yi ril bu la/ /bsnyen dang sgrub pa'i lhar gnas pa/ /sngags kyi ngo 'or shes par bya/ / dpal bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ las sna tshogs kyi dum bu ste le'u gsum pa'o// //

0 bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud com ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje gnod gnas la serdzogs pa dang / rnal 'gyor ma dpag tu med pa'i 'khor de dag rjes su yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /kha che'i mkhan po dz+nyā na badz+ras rang 'gyur du mdzad pa rdzogs so// //sarba maṅga lam̐// //

rgyud don gsalobar byed pa'i thig le 44/ /bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs serdzo//ra༅༅/ /sku gsum stor med bde chen lhan cig skyes/ /zag med ye shes thugs rje'i rnam sprul gyis/ / mkha' mnyam sems can smin cing grol mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /byin rlabs mthar thug gsang chen zab mo'i rgyud/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam 'khor 'o( sdom pa yi/ /rgyud don rnam bshad nyams su blangs pa'i tshul/ /dri med bla ma'i zhal gdams bshad par bya/ /de la spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thugs rje che la7thabs mkhas pa/ gdul bya sems can gyi khams dang bag la nyal ba dang bsam pa la dgongs nas chos kyi gsor lo rim pa gsum du gsungs te/dang por wā rā ṇa sīr bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / gnyis pa bya rgod phung po'i ri la mtshan ma med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo

2 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le bskor ba dang / gsum pa gyad kyi yul du nges pa don gyi chos kyi gsor lo bskor ba ste/ de ltar sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum gsungs/de nas snyigs ma lnga'i dus kyi gdul bya nyon mongs pa'i stobes chen po mi bzad pa rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ ā/ rgyan dang 'og min la serdzogs pa'i gnas su gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa gsungs te/ de ltar yang /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/skye bo 'dod chags can don du/ /de yi byed pa rdo rje sems/ /zhes gsungs sem/ /de bas na theg pa chen po gsang sngags te/ sde snedi bzhi par 'gyur te/ sde snod rin yo che rnam pa gsum ni theg pa chen po gsang sngags la sbyor ba'i rgyur 'gro la/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg par tshe gcig gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas par ston pa ni/ 'bras bu'i theg pa ste/de ltar yang / gsang ba lung bstan pa'i mdo las/rgyu la sbyor ba rgyu yi chos/ /'khor lo shin tu bskor byas nas/ /'bras bu'i theg pa nye lam zhig /dus tshigs phyi mar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /

rgyud don gsalobar byed pa'i thig le 3zhes gsungs sesgo/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la yang rgyud sde bzhi ste/ bya ba dang /spyod pa dang / rnal 'gror dang / rnal 'gyor bla na med pa'i rgyud do/ /de yang gdul bya sems can nyon mosnangs pa 'dod chags kyi tshul rnam pa bzhi dag par bya ba'i phyir gnyen por gsungs pa yin te/ de ltar yang / saṃ bu ṭa 'o/sa//bltas dang rberted pas 'khrig pa dang / /gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcangs dang / /srin bu'i tshul gyis rgyud bzhir gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de ltar yang / rgyu nyon mongs pa'i stobs che chung bzhi la rnal 'gror gyi stobs kyis nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu rim gyis myur ba'i phyir gang zag gi khyad par bzhi la dgongs pa yang yin te/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje sdi/ra las//dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'gror de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'gyor rgyud/ /rnal 'gyor bla med de ltag la'o/ /

14 rgyud donagasal bar byed pa'i thig le zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i rgyud sde bzhi las/ 'di rnal 'gror bla na med pa'o/ /de la yang pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis las/ rnal 'gyor ma'i rgyud do/ /ma rgyud la dgyes pa rdo rje dang / gsor lo sdom pa dang / rdo rje gdan bzhi dang / ma hā mā yā dang bzhi las/ 'di 'khor lo sdom pa'o/ /de la rtsa ba'i rgyud dang /bshad pa'i rgyud las/ 'di bshad pa'i rgyud do/ /de la yang dang po gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa dang / rgyud dngos bshad pa dang / rgyud yongs su rdzogs pa'i don rjes su yi rang gsum las /— dang po 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na zhes bya ba ni/'di skad kyis chos phun sum tshogs pa ste/ rgyud 'di ṣ+ka thos pa'o/ /gang gis thos na bdag gis thos pa ste/ chos de nyid sgro bskur dang bral ba'o/ /dus gcig na bya ba ni/ dus phun sum tshogos pa yin te/ dus bakhrig gi tshe rgyud 'di byung zhing / gzhan du ma byung bas na rgyud 'di 'byung bar dka' ba dang / sdud pa po shes rab che ba'o/ /gang la thos na bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba stoni pa phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /bdud bzhi bcom zhing sku gsum ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o/ /gnas gang du thos na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung

rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le 5dang thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i r+bha ga la bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes bya bas te/ /btsun mo ni chos kyi dbyings yin la/ bha ga bde ba chen po'i gnas rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyis stong pa'i gnas su'o/ /bzhugs pa ni sku gsum dbyer med pa bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa'o/ /'khor ni rdo rje snying po la sogs pa'o/ /des phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang ldan pa'i rgyud dngos bshad pa la snyas te/ brjod bya r+pā gyi rgyud dang / sgo byed sgra'i rgyud do/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rgyu'i rgyud dang / thabs kyi rgyud dang / 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /de skad du yang / dpal dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud las/rgyud ces bya ba rgyun yin te/ /gnas skabs gsum gyi dri ma dang / /'jug dang zhugs dang nges pa dang / /rgyu dang thabs dang 'bras bu ste/ /dang po gsor ba'i rang bzhin la/ / gnyis pa thun mosnang mya ngan 'das/ /zhes gsungs serdzo/ /de la rgyu'i rgyud ni/ sems can thams cad kyi sems rang bzhin gyis dag pa chos nyid du gnas pa ste/ dpal bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud

6 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le las/sangs rgyas rnams ni byung gyur ram/ /ma byung na yang rnam kun tu/ /bsam gyis mi khyab chos nyid 'di/ /'phel 'grib spangs par gnas pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar gnas par gyur kyang glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs pas ma rtogs pa yin te/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud las/sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /wo kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs/ /de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa thabs kyi rgyud la smin lam dbang gis rgyu'i rgyud ngo shes par byas nas/ grol lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis nyams su len pa ste/dpal stobs po che'i rgyud las/'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bstan par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ /

rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le 7de nyid mthong na rnam par grol/ /zhes gsungs sku(/ /gsum pa 'bras bu'i rgyud ni/ lam bskyed rdzogs kyi don nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu sku gsum mngone du 'gyur ba ste/ dpal dur khrodi rgyan gyi rgyud las/ / lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhinal/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi ngo bor 'dus/ /yodi pa rgyu la bsgrub pa lam/ /mngon gyur 'bras bu'i ngo bo yin/ / zhes so/ /gnyis pa rjod byed sgra'i rgyud la yang gsum ste/ rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /dang po ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyis byin rlabs kyi rdo rje snying po zhes bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes zhus pa'i spobs pa bskyed de/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ kye bcom ldan 'das zhes bos nas/gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba/ /gsang chen dam pa bshad du gasku1la/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das la zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal

8 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le pa rdo rje snying po khyod nyon cig /srog dang lnga pa de bzhin du/ /lam dang 'bras bu nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas/srog ni rlung sems kyi rgyun yin la/ lnga pa ni phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga po ste/ sems can gyi phung po dang khams dang / skye mched bdag tu 'odzin pa'o/ /de dag gi don rdo rje snying pos/ bcom ldan 'das la srog gang lags zhus pas/ bcerdzom ldan 'das kyis bka' brgyu'il pa/ srog ni 'dzin par byed pa ste/ /sngags dang sems dang rten nyid do/ /zhes pas/ sems can gyi lus la rtsa yi ge rnam pa yi/ li kā lir gnas pa yin la/ der rlung sems tshogs pa'i rkyen gyis ngag dang tshig dang yi ge'i sgrar 'ong ste/ sngags thams cad ni thabs dang shes rab kyi yi ge dbyangs gsal byed yin zhing / sems can gyi ngag thams cad kyang de las ma 'das pa'i phyir gdod ma nas sngags kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa'o/ /de rnams kyang bsdus pas snying po'i yi ge 'gru gsum du gnas pa yin te/ rlung nang du 'jug pa tshu( gyi rang bzhin/ nang na gnas pa āḥ 'i rang

rgyud don gsalobar byed pa'i thig le 9bzhin/ phyir ldang ba sh+lau gi rang bzhin te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po skul bar byed pa sngags zhes bya'o/ /sngags de yang bsdus na skye ba med pa shes rab kyi rang bzhin a dang thabs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin haṃ du gnas pa yin te/ dang po ma'i mngal nas thoni nas a haṃ zhes sngags bzlos par byed pa'o/ /de ltar yang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud 'o/sa//sngags kyi bzlas pa a dang haṃ/ /zhes pa dang / dam tshig chen po'i rgyud las/a dang haṃ gi rang bzhin gyis/ /sngags kyi ngo bor shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /sems dang zhes bya ba ni/ sems can thams cad kyi sems rgyud rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba chos kyi sku gdod ma nas gnas pa yin te/ dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa las/chu khams gser dang nam mkha' bzhin/ / rang bzhin gyis ni dag par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'o/ /de ltar khams rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i sems nyid chos

20 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le kyi sku de ma rig pa'i rkyen las skyes pa'i gzung 'dzin rnam par rtog pa glo bur du shar yang / rtog pa de nyid/ rang bzhin gyis skye ba med par gnas pas na sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes bya'o/ /rten nyid ces pa ni/ rten rang gi lus 'di nyid gdod ma nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi skur gnas pa yin te/ sems nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de las rkyen gyi dbang gis chags sdang gis rnam par rtog pa gang yang rung ba skyes pa de'i dus su grub kyang / rtog pa de gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yin pas de'i lus kyang shrī he ru ka gnyis su med pa ye shes kyi thugs zhes bya ste/ mkha' 'grerdzo ma kun tu spyodad pa'i rgyud las/shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni bkod pa dang bral ba/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lus 'di nyid kyang snang stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku'o/ /de dag rgyas par zhu ba'i phyir/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das lnga pa gang lags zhes zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das tshurmis bka' rgyus5 pa/ sangs rgyas lnga dang 'byung ba lnga/ /

rgyud don gsadze+ebar byed pa'i thig le 2 zhes sa/sungs pas/ sangs rgyas lnga ni dpal he ru ka de nyid kyi gzugs kyi phung tsho rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung tsho rdo rje nyi ma ste rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /'du shes kyi phung po ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ste 'od dpag med do/ /'du byed kyi phung po ni rdo rje rgyal po ste don yod grub pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid du gyur pa ni dpal he ru ka ste gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku'o/ /'byung ba lnga zhes bya ba ni yum lnga ste/ sha sa'i khams ni sangs rgyas spyan ma'o/ /khrag chu'i khams ni mā ma ki'o/ /drod me'i khams ni gos dkar mo'o/ /dbugs rlung gi khams ni sgrol ma'o/ /sgo nam mkha'i khams ni dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i rang bzhin te/ de thams cad kyi bdag nyid du gyur pa ni rje btsun ma rnal 'gyor ma ste yum mo/ /lnga pa yang ni gcig nyid do/ /zhes pa ni/ yab sangs rgyas lnga dang yum lha mo lnga yang dpal he ru ka gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi skur gcig pa ste/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur 'a/sa//gzugs sogs so sor snang ba rnams/ /sems nyid kho na snang ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi

22 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le sku gsung thugs su gtan la phab pa'o /da ni lam gyi rgyud bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das lam gang lags zhus pas/ bcomo ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lam la rnam pa gnyis te/smin pa dang ni grol ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rgyu'i rgyud gdod ma nas sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs su gnas pa de/ sngar ma rtogs pa dbang gis rtogs shing rgyud smin par byas nas/ grole ba'i lam gyis nyams su len par byed pa'o/ /lam de dag rgyas par zhu ba'i phyir/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das smin pa'i lam ni gang lags/ zhes zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/bum pa gsang ba shes rab dang / /bzhi pa'i rang bzhin ngo bo ste/ /de yi rnam pa de la gnas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bum pa'i dbang gis lus su 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag nas lhar shes par bya ba dang / gsang ba'i dbang gis ngag tu 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag nas sngags su shes par bya ba dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gis sems su 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag nas chos nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od

rgyud doni gsal bar byed pa'i thig le 23gsal bar shes par bya ba dang / dbang bzhi pas de gsum kar 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag nas yang dag pa'i ye shes blo las 'das pa shes par bya ste/ de skad du yang / dpal dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud las/bum pas lus kyi dri ma 'khru/ /gnyis pas ngag gi dri ma 'khru/ /gsum pas sems kyi dri ma ste/ /de ni kun tu dag pa las/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa/ /bkru ba'i phyir ni bzhi par bshad/ /zhes so/ /de nas yang / rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das grol ba'i lam ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/snying rje chen po las skyes pa/ /dga' ba'i dza/gas las rnam par grupa/ /zhes gsungs pas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad ma yin zhing / ma de rnams 'khrul pas rang gi de kho na nyid gsum ma rtogs pas 'kherdzor bar 'khyams pa rnams la/ sems can la dmigs pa dang /chos la dmigs pa dang / dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos gsor ba

24 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral te bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par dka' ba'i byang chub kyi sems ni sa 'on rnam par shes pa yin la/bsam pa de las grub pa'i lus ni/thabs dang shes rab gnyis med mchog /bde ba chen po'i lam yin no/ /zhes gsungs serdzo/ /thabs ni yab ste dpal he ru ka yin la/ shes rab ni yum ste rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'gyor ma'o/ /gnyis med mchog ces pa ni/ yab yum gnyis su med par rol pas zag med kyi bde ba chen po rgyas pa ste/ dpal bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud las/lha dang mi yi bde ba ni/ /bsdus byas rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zhes gsungs se1/ /de dag kyang rgyas par bstan pa'i phyir/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das he ru ka ni gang lags/ rnal 'gror ma ni gang lags zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/he ru ka ni phung h+phu da/ /

rgyud done gsa.ā+obar byed pa'i thig le 25phung po yang ni he ru ka /zhes gsungs pas/ dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba gang zhe na/ rang gi gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa'i phung po lnga po nyid gdod ma nas rigs lnga'i rang bzhin dpal he ru ka'i sku gsung thugs yoni tan phrin las lngar gnas pa'i phyir gnyis su med cing gnyis su byar med de gcig pa'o/ /khams ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /rdo rje ma dpal khams nyid do/ /zhes pa ni/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang nam mkha'i khams lnga po gdod ma nas yum rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'gyor ma'i rang bzhin du yum lngar gnas te/ gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med pa'i phyir gcig pa'o/ /skye mched kyang ni de bzhin du/ / lha yi ngo bor shes par bya/ /zhes pa ni/ phung po lnga yab lnga dang 'byung ba lnga yum lnga por 'dus pa'i lus ni dpal he ru ka yab yum yin la/ de'i skye mched ni byang chub sems dpa' drug ste/ spyan gsum ni byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam par sel ba'o/ /rna ba ni byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje'o/ /sna ni byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snyingawa'o/ /lce ni byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras

26 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le gzigs dbang phyug berte/ /lus kyi tshigs thams cad ni byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'o/ /yid ni byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal 'ordzo/ /de thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i lus de'i chos nyid la dpal he ru ka zhes bya'o/ /de nas sku'i rnam par dag pa rgyas par bstan pa'i phyir/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das phung po'i he ru ka gang lags/ khams kyi rdo rje rnal 'gror ma gang lags/ zhes zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das krishās bka' bsum pa/he ru ka dpal bdag nyid dngos/ /zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas gzhan nas bsgrub tu med de/ rang nyid gdod ma nas sangs rgyas yin pa la ngo shes par bya ba ste/ de skad du yang / gsang ba snying po'i rgyud las/bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo thams cad nyid dang ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rang nyid yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de'i mtshan nyid ni/dri ma med pa'i kha dog can/ /zhes pa ni nam mkha' dri ma med pa bai ḍūr+ya chag pa'i 'phro ltar sngo bsang

rgyud don gsalobar byed pa'i thig le 27ste/ chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la glo bur gyi dri mas ma gos pa'o/ /thams cad chos skur ro gcig pas na zhal gcig pa'o/ /bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i phyir mche ba gtsigs pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa ste/ /zhes pa ni/ rdo rje ni dug lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du dag pa'i phyir/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa dang / dngos por 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba mtha' dag las grerdzol ba'i phyir phyag g.yon na dril bu bsnams pa gnyis bsnol te yum la 'khyud pa'o/ / drug gis brgyan cing dgu dang ldan/ /zhes pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug skurdzongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir spyi gtsug gi nor bu dang / rna rgyan dang / mgul rgyan dang / phyag gdub dang / ske rags dang / thal bas te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ dasdo/ dang ldan pa ni/sgeg pa dang / dpa' dang / 'jigs su rung ba ste sku'i nyams gsum dang /rberted pa dang / rngam pa dang / gshe ba ste gsung gi nyams gsum dang /snying rje ba dang / zhi ba dang / ngo mtshar ba ste thugs kyi nyams gsum dang ldan pa ste gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o/ /zla tshes sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /zhes pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba sel zhing khams byang chub kyi sems

28 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le dang ldan pa'i phyir/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi g.yon phyogs na zla ba phyed pa bsil ba'i 'od dang ldan pas brgyan pa/ phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i phyir g.yas phyogs su sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /rigs kyi bdag pos rnam par brgyan/ / zhes pa ni/ thugs kyi rigs mtshon pa'i phyir thub pa mi bskyode pas dbu rgyan du mdzad pa'o/ /spyan ga༄/ma dag gis zhes bya ba ni dus gsum mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i phyir spyan gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /mdzes pa ste/ /zhes pa ni ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir skra mtshams na phar la rigs lnga'i ngo bor thod pa skam po rdo rje'i thag pas brgyus pa lngas spras pa'o/ ci/rten gyi spyod pa kun las grol ba'i phyir ral pa gyen du brjes pa'i cod pan gyi rtse mo serdzogs kha na mar 'phyang ba/ 'du byed lnga bcu rtsa gcig dag pa dang ā li kā li lnga bcu 'phyang ba'i phyir mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba do shal du byas la / thugs rjes sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i phyir sum /khugs su 'khyog pa'i da ra dgrangs kyis mdzes par byas pa'o/ /chags pa med pa'i sham thabs can/ /

rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le 29 zhes pa ni/ mtshan dang / dpe byad dang / stso(bas dang mi 'jigs pa la serdzogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /phyin ci 'ordzog drug 'joms pa'i phyir stag gi pags pas sham thabs byas pa6rdzo/ /shes rab rang bzhin rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes pa ni/ yum rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'gyor ma'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'o/ /ban du dzi ka'i kha dog can/ /zhes pa ni/ me tog ban du dzi ka'am/ dzha ba sin+dha ra'i kha dog ltar dmar ba ste/ thugs rjes sems can la chags shing bla'i ba dbang du sdud pa'o/ /gcer bu zhes pa ni gos med pas te chos nyid sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba'o/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing / /zhes pa ni yum shes rab kyi rang bzhin la shes rab kyis rgyas gdab mi dbordzos pas/ thal ba spangs pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o/ /dag pa lnga bcu'i phreng bas mdzes/ /zhes pa ni/ kun rdzob tu 'du byed kyi rtog pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig dag pa'i phyir thod pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi phreng bas do shal byas pa'o/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i snod bsnams pa/ /zhes pa ni/ nyon mongs pa lnga dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad chos nyid stong

30 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le pa nyid kyis 'joms pa'i phyir phyag g.yas kyi sdig mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje bsnams pa/ bdud bzhi'i khrag la rol zhing zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyodang ba'i phyir thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa'o/ /yab la 'khyud cing zhes pa ni/ phyag g.yoni pas thod pa yab la stob pa'i tshul du 'byud pa'o/ /brkyang bskum tshul/ /zhes pa ni/ stosnang pas 'khor ba la mi gnas pa'i zhabs g.yas bskum ste yab la 'khyud pa'o/ /snying rjes mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas pa'i zhabs g.yoni brkyangs pa/ rnam par rtog pa'i 'ching ba las grerdzol ba'i phyir dbu skra nag po'i tshogs so/ /ye shes lnga mtshon pa'i phyir/ skra mtshams na phar thod pa skam po lngas spras pa'o/ /gnyis med bde ba la rgyas pa/ /zhes pa ni/ dga' ba bcu drug mtshon pa'i phyir/ bu mo lo bcu drug ma ltar gzugs mdzes shing lang tsho rgyas pa/ gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba brtson zhing bde ba rgyas pa'o/ /chu skyes nyi ma'i dbus su 'gying / /zhes pa ni/ rin po che bzhi las grub pa'i ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng du gdan sna chogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'jigs byed

rgyud don gsalabar byed pa'i thig le 31chen po dang dus mtshan gyi steng du bzhugs pa'o/ /khams nyid lha'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes pa ni sa la sogos pa'i khams thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin te yum lnga'i bdag nyid do/ /de ltar bdag nyid lus gar+pā ma nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad bdag nyid dpal he ru ka yab yum gyi skur gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin las ma yengs par bsgom pa ni/ lus rnam par dag pa bskyed pa'i rim pa bstan pa'i le'u dang po'i rnam par bshad pa'ordzo/ / //da ni le'u gnyis pa sems rnam par dag par rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa'i phyir/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rang bzhin 'is rnam pyor dag r+pā ri gar+pā lagah+phu/ ngo bo rnyitre 'i rod gas nu ba ri gadzā 'a/gas// zhesu zhusu pusu/ burtomā ldan zhadasu rmyes bka' bsnyul pa/brtan dang gasku( ba thams cad kyi/ /shes rab rang bzhin nyid yin te/ /zhes pa ni chos thams cad gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing skye ba med par gnas pa yin te/ brtan pa ni snod kyi 'jig rten yin la/g.yo ba ni bcud kyi sems can yin te/ de thams cad chos nyid stong pa nyid du gdodi ma nas gnas pa'i phyir shes rab kyi rang bzhin chosgos thams cad de

32 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le bzhin nyid du gcig pa'o/ /de gang yin na rang gi sems yin la/ sems de'i rang bzhin sku(ngas su dag pa yin te/ snang ba med pa'i snang ba rnam par dag pa/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha'i mtshan nyid do/ /de lta bu'i sems kyi de bzhin nyid tha snyad kyi yul las 'das pa'i phyir sems nyid ma bcos pa'i don mngon du byed pa ma gtogs pa/ sgra dang tha snyad gang gis kyang brjode par mi nus te/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang / /bdag gis bsku(da nams las shes bya/ /zhes so/ /der rang gi bsod nams dang bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis nyams su myong bas na/ mtshon bya don gyi lhan cig skyes pa zhes kyang bya/ 'od gsal la don dam pa'i bden pa ces kyang bya/ phyag rgya chen po zhes kyang bya'o/ /mngon du byed pa'i man ngag la gnyis te/ dbang po 'bring gis rjes su gzhigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rim gyis mngon du bya ba dang / dbang po rab kyis ril por 'dzin pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis cig car du mngon du bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/

rgyud don gsalobar byed pa'i thig le 33lha yi ngo bo 'od gsal nyid/ /ces gsungs pas/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka'i skar gnas pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i yi ge tram̐/ ṇ+ḍaṃ cha lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bo 'od zer dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa bltas la/ de'i 'od kyis brtan pa snod dang g.yo ba bcud kyi dngos po thams cad rimaji gyis 'od du zhu nas yum la bsdu/ yum yab la bsdu/ yab thugs ka'i rmye la bsdu/ tram̐ yang rim gyis zhu nas zhabs kyu dang / ha dang / zla tshes dang / thig le dang /nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ mthar thams cad stosnang pa rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i sems gdod ma nas skye ba med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bur gnas pa de la ma yengs par gzhag par bya6sna/ /gnyis pa dbang po rab kyis ril por 'dzin pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis gcig car du mngon du bya ba ni/ma skyes rtog pa bral ba'i sku/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lha'i rnal 'gror de nyid kyi ngang las skad cig gis rang gi sems nyid gdod ma nas skye ba med pa gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa dang / bsgom bya sgom byed kyi blo thams cad dang bral ba/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i 'od gsal chos kyi sku ngo shes par byas la/sems nyid ma bcos par bzhag par bya'o/ /de ji ltar bskyang ba'i thabs la

34 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le bzhi ste/ bsgom bya sgom byed kyi yid la byar med pa bskyang ba dang / glod nas bskyang ba dang / rang dgar du bskyang ba dang / ngang du gnas pa'o/ /dang po ni chos thams cad sems su shes par byas la/ sems nyid rnam par dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu'i ngang du/ bsgom bya sgom byed kyis yid la byar med par gzhag go/ /de skad du yang dgyes pa rdo rje las/'di ltar yid kyis ma bsgoms na/ /'gro ba thams cad bsgom pa'o/ /thams cad chos nyid yin zhe na/ /bsgom du med cing bsgom pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa glod nas bskyang ba ni/ bram ze skud pa 'khel ba lta bu ste/ grim pa na 'chad cing rnal du mi 'dod/ glod na mi 'chad pa bzhin du rnal 'gyor pas kyang sems nyid skye ba med pa rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba de bzhin nyid kyi ngang du glod nas bzhag pas/ bying rgod du mi 'gyur zhing ngang du gnas pa'o/ /gasra/ma pa rang dgar bskyang ba ni mkhas pa ba lang 'tshor ba lta bu ste/de la dpe gnyis/ yan par btang ba dang ma yengs par 'cho ba gnyis/de bzhin du sems nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang du yan par bzhag pa dang / shes

rgyud don gsalobar byed pa'i thig le 35rab mig gis ma yengs par blta ba'o/ /bzhi pa ngang du gnas pa ni/ brjod du med cing bsam mi khyab/ /rtog pa med pa nam mkha'i dbus/ / zhes gsungs pas/ don de nyid tshig tha snyad kyis brjod du med pas ngag smra brjod dang bral bar gnas par bya/ sems yid la byar med cing bsgom du med pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang du gnas par bya'o/ /dgag sgrub kyi blo dang bral bas brtson 'grus kyi rtog pa med par gnas par bya/ de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin nyid la mtha' dbus med pa/ dbyibs dang kha dog med pa/ dngos po dang mtshan ma med pa/ nam mkha'i dbus ltar gnas par bya'o/ /de yang dber na gzings las 'phur ba'i bya rgya mtsho chen po'i dkyil nas gar 'phur yang chu med pa'i rten sa ma rnyed pas slar gzings la chagasapa de bzhin du/ sems 'di yang gang du 'phros kyang chos nyid stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin de ma yin pa'i rten sa med pas skye ba med pa'i chos nyid du gnas pa yin no/ /da ni zung 'jug bstan pa'i phyir/gnyis med bde ba'i rnam pa can/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sems nyid rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba de las snang ba sna tshogs su 'char ba gang yin zhe na/ rgyu ma rig pa las rkyen rlung gis

36 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le gsor 'das kyi rtog pa sna tshogs su skye zhing snang yang rang gi ngo bo la skye ba med pa yin te/ dpal rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud las/ji/ ma rlung gi khams ga༄/ma pa/ /rmi lam rmis pa bzhin du mthong / /khams ga༄/ma bdag med de bzhin nyid/ /gcig tu gyur par mthong ba ni/ /byin gyis brlabs nas de bzhin nyid/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur / /zhes pa dang / mdo gsang ba'i snying po las skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes tsam nyid na skye ba med/ /zhes pa dang /gang gis rkyen las skyes pa de la skye ba'i rang bzhin skusnad ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bas na snang ba de nyid stong pa yin zhing stong pa nyid sna tshogs su snang bas na/ snang stosnang gnyis su med pa'i phyir zung du 'jug pa zhes bya'o//bde ba'i rnam pa can zhes bya ba ni/ thams cad stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba de nyid kyi ngang las/ rgyu kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang / rkyen gdul bya dag pa'i snang ba la zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sku

rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le 37dpal he ru ka yab yum du ldang ba ste/ de la ni rdo rje'i sku zhes kyang bya/zung du 'jug pa zhes kyang bya/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhes kyang bya ste/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje las/ rdo rje stong pa nyid du brjod/ /srid gsum gcig pa sems dpa' ste/ /shes rab sems dpa' 'di la ni/ / rdo rje sems dpa' zhes su brjod/ /zhes pa dang / dang nge maḥsnag gi rgyud las kyang /nyams su myong ba ma skyes te/ /dang po thams cad de bzhin du/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du/ /'gro ba rnams ni thub pas gsungs/ /zhes so/ /de ltar 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad zung 'jug tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/gsal ba'i rang bzhin ga81 ba med/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rtogs pa dang ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / rtogs pa dang ma rtogs pa zhes tha snyad du brjod kyang rang bzhin gyis

38 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thigale 'od gsal ba de las g.yerdzo ba med de/ dper na 'khrul pas thag pa sprul du snang ba dang / sprul bsal nas thag pa bsgrub tu med pa de bzhin du/ ma rtogs pa rnams la gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa tha dad du snang yang / de nyid skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin yin pas/ rtog pa bsal ba dang mi rtog pa bsgrub tu med de/ zung du 'jug pa yin no/ /de skad du slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub krisno zhal nas/po'akhror ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /rtog pa gnyis po spangs nas ni/ /gang du dngos po gcig gyur pa/ /zung du 'jug ces de la bshad/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar 'gro drug srid pa'i btson rar gnas pa'i dus dang / sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar dang / lhun gyis grub pa 'bras bu'i dus gsum ka la rtogs ma rtogs kyi gnas skabs tha dad kyang / ngo bo chos nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba de la 'gyur ba med pas na g.yo ba med pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis su med pa zung 'jug mchog /ces pa ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gnyis su med par rtogs pa lta ba'i zung 'jug dang / rtogs pa de nang nas shar zhing nyams su myong ba

rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le 39ye shes kyi zung 'jug dang / gnyis med kyi done de la ma yengs par nyams su len pa bsgom pa'i zung 'jug dang / mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob gnyis su med pa spyod pa'i zung 'jug go/ /mchog ces bya ba ni/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad gnyis med kyi ye shes de las ma 'das pas/ dgag pa dang /sgrub pa dang / spang bya dang / gnyen po dang / rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu thams cad ro gcig tu gyur pas dbang po lnga'i spyod yul dgag sgrub med cing ci dang ci byed pa thams cad snang ba phyag rgya chen por rtogs pas mchog ces bya'o/ /gsum pa/'bras bu lam gyi rnam pa'o/ /zhes pa ni 'bras bu sku gsum ste/ chos kyi sku khams rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing glo ngur gyi dri ma dag pa'i dag pa gnyis dang ldan pa'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i sku la zhing khams du ma snang zhing / zhing khams du mar skus khyab pa'o/ /sprul pa'i sku ni rigs kyi thub pa drug la sku1gas pa mchogo dang / dman pa dang / skye ba'i sprul pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams yin la/ lam gyi rnam pa'o/ /zhes pas 'bras bu de rnams gzhan na yode pa ma yin/ chos kyi sku ni rang gi sems nyidari rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing 'od gsal bar gnas pa ste/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag dang / bsam gtan gnyis kyis ngo sprad

40 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le nas nyams su blangs pas/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba de la chos kyi sku zhes bya'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni dngos po snang ba med pa de nyid kyis khyab pas na rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ste zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi sku zhes bya'o/ /de yang sku'i rnam pa gsal ba dngos por 'dzin pas stong pas na gsal stong zung du 'jug pa'o/ /nyams myong bde ba la zag bcas kyi dri mas stong pa dang / thabs snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin he ru ka dang / shes rab stong pa nyid rang bzhin rdo rje rnal 'gror ma gnyis su med pa ni thabs shes rab zung du 'jug pa ste/ de ni gnyis su med pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes bya'o/ /sprul pa'i sku ni bskyed pa'i rim pa lha'i rnal 'byor la brtan pa thob pas lus ngag gi bya ba dang / byed pa thams cad lha dang sngags kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa des phrin las bzhi gang la gang 'dul gyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar 'bras bu sku gsum gdode ma nas gnas pa de rtogs par byas nas nyams su len pas na lam gyi rnam pa'o/ /sems rnam par dag pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa ste le'u gnyis pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //da ni ngag— rnam par dag pa sngags kyi rim pa bstan pa'i phyir/ rdo rje snying pos gserdzol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ngag rnam par dag pa ni gang lags zhus pas/ bcerdzom ldan 'das kyis bka' ba3/la pa/

rgyud done gsalobar byed pa'i thig le 4 sngags dang sbyin sreg gtor ma dang / /maṇ+ḍal dang ni de bzhin du/ /bum pa'i ngo bo lhar shes pa/ /sngags kyi de bzhin nyid gnas pa'o/ /zhes mdor bstan nas de dag gi don rgyas par bstan pa'i phyir/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sngags ni gang / sbyin sreg ni gang /gtor ma ni gang / maṇ+ḍal ni gang / bum pa ni gang / sngags kyi de bzhin nyid ni gang lags zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/sngags ni gsang sngags rgyal po ste/ /zhes pas de la sngags dngos bstan pa dang / las tshogs bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni bsgen pa'i sngags dang / nye ba'i bsnyen pa'i sngags dang / bzlas pa'i man ngag bstan pa'o/ /yab yum gyi bsgen pa dang / nye ba'i bsnyen pa rgyud na gsal lo/ /gdams ngag la gsum ste/ rlung brtan pa dang / thig le brtan pa dang / spro bsdu'i bzlas pa'o/ /dang po rnam par rtog pa shas che ba rnams rlung brtan pa'i bzlas pa bya ste/ bdag nyid he ru kar gnas pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ṇ+ḍaṃ la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs te bzlas pa byas pa sngags kyi phreng ba rlung dang lhan cig tu rang

42 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le gi sna bug g.yoni pa nas thoni ste/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad lhar gnas pa'i sna bug g.yas pa nas zhugs nas snying ka'i hūṃ gnas pa la thim/ hūṃ la sngags kyi phreng ba sems can gyi sna bug galdon pa nas thon te/ rang gi sna bug g.yas par zhugs nas thugs ka'i tram̐ la thim zhing 'khor bar dmigs te bzlas pa bya'o/ /gnyis pa nyone mongs pa shasda che na/ thig le brtan pa'i bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kha dog dkar po/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin du rtsa dbu ma'i nang na mar song nas gsang ba'i rdo rje nas thon te yum gyi r+bha gar zhugs/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang na yar yum gyi zhal nas byon te/ yab kyi zhal du 'khor ba'i tshul du bzlas pa bya'o/ /gsum pa spro bsdu'i bzlas pa ni/ thugs ka'i tram̐ las sngags sbrul 'khyil ba ltar ba〉snar bar bsams la/ 〈snag pa'i tshul du sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /zhi ba la sngags kha dog dkar po mu tig gi phreng ba ltar 'khor bar dmigs te bzlas par bya'o/ /rgyas pa la mda'i shugs lta bu ste yab yum gyi sngags gnyis po bsgril nes mda' sgro gnyis ma'i tshul du 'od zer ser po : shing bzlas so/ /dbang la yab yum gyi sngags zhugs pa lcags sgrog bzhin du 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing bzlas pa bya'o/ /drag po la dmar nag me lce mched pa'i tshul du 'phro zhing bzlas pa'o/ /bzlas pa'i phan yoni

rgyud don gsalobar byed pa'i thig le 43bstan pa ni/gsang sngags rgyal po 'di dag gis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bsten pa dang nye ba'i bsten pa'o/ /bskal pa stong la sogs pa ni/ /zhes pa ni/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa rnams so/ /sdig pa ma lus dag byed chu/ /zhes pa ni/ dug gsum gyi dbang gis lus dang ngag dang yid kyi 〉( nas mtshams med pa lnga dang de dang nye ba lnga la sogs pa las dang nyoni mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad dag par byed pa'o/ /da ni las myur du bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir/ sbyin sreg bstan par bya ste/ gru bzhi pa la 〉( bzhi pa/ /zhes pa ni/ sa'i cho ga blang ba dang / bsrung ba la sogs bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi bris pa la/'khor lo dag gi rnam par mdzes/ /zhes pas dbus su blum skor la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bri/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang 'khor lo'i phreng bas bskor bar bri bar bya'o/ /lte ba ni zhi ba la zlum po kha dog dkar po/ dbang la zla gam dmar po/ rgyas pa

44 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thigale la gru bzhi ser po/ drag po la gru gsum nag po/a shwa ta dang n+ya gro ta/ /dur ba la sogs de bzhin du/ /zhes pa ni/ bsreg pa'i rdzas yam shing dang til dang zho dang / 'bras dang / sran chen dang / ku sha dang / dur ba'o/ /thab rtsig pa ni/ zhi ba la dza/ga pa dang bal bu/ rgyas pa la 'o ma can dang / dbang la tsan+dan dang seng ldeng / drag po la dug shing dang tsher ma can gyi shing / thab dang mthun par brtsigs la me sbar te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha gsal bar bskyed de/ lha sngags dang / rdzas sngags dang / las sngags gsum sbrel la dbul bar bya'o/ /grangs ni bdun bdun no/ /mchod pa dang bstode pa la sogs pas mnyes par byas la dkyil 'khor bsdu bar bya'o/ /zhi ba la zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ rgyas pa la rgyas pa'i sems dang ldan pa / dbang la dgug pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ drag po la gsad pa'i sems dang ldan pas bya'o/ /da ni thun mtshams gtor ma bstan pa'i phyir/ sha lnga dang ni bdud rtsi lnga/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gtor ma la gnyis te phyi dang nang gi gtor ma'o/ /dang po ni ka pā la sogs pa'i snod ji ltar 'gror ba'i nang du sha dang chang la

rgyud don gsalabar byed pa'i thig le 45sogs pa bshams/ rlung me sbud sbar gyi sbyor bas legs par sbyangs la dam tshig dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gnyis su med par bsre ste/ 'gron rnams spyan drangs pa ni/gyen du h+pha gyi sgra sgrogs pas/ /zhes pa ni thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer dang / lus kyi rkang pa g.yas pas g.yoni pa'i mthe bong mnan te/ he ru ka dam tshig gi phyag rgya byas la/ ngag tu h+pha brjod pas dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs la / dpa' bo rnal 'gror ma kun dgyes/ /zhes gsungs pas/ me togo la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa dang / gzugs la sogs pa nang gi mchod pa dang / gsang ba'i mchodi pa legs par sbyangs pa'i gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /nang gi mchod pa ni/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo byin gyis brlabs pa'i kha zas kyi phung po dang / khams dang skye mched kyi lha tshogs rnams mchod par bya'o/ /da ni phyi rol gyi mchod pa dang maṇ+ḍal dang lag pa'i mchod pa bstan pa'i phyir/bdud rtsi legs par byugs nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pas/ maṇ+ḍal chag chag legs par btab pa'i steng du bdud rtsi dang chang dang tsan+dan gyi chus legs par byugs pa la de'i dbus su lag

46 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis mnan te/ snying yo dang nye ba'i snying po brjod pas/ maṇ+ḍal de yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rang bzhin lha'i gzhal yas khang du mos par bya/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dpal he ru ka yab yum du bskyed/ de'i phyogs kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma bzhi dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo dang / byang du lā ma ljang khu dang / nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mosna/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas na rigs kyi mtshan pa'i rdo rje gri gug dang g.yod thod pa khrag gi gang ba bsnams pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ldan pa/ rus pa'i rgyan dang bcas pa'o/ /de rnams la ye shes kyi dal spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bsams la phyag bya ba dang me togo la sku(gas pa'i mchodi pa dbul ba dang / sdig pa bshags pa la serdzogs pa yan lag bdun pa bya ba dang / bdud rtsi dang tshogs mchod 'bul bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa lag pa'i mchodi pa bya ba ni/ lag pa bdud rtsis legs par byugs te/ bsang ga|rdzor byas la pad+ma 'dab ma lngar bsam/ 'dab ma lnga dbus dang drug la oṃ baṃ/ haṃ oṃ dz+rī oṃ/ hro hro/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod cing me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ mthe bong la sogs pa'i sor mo rnams la/ oṃ haḥ na ma hi/ su ha hwa/ sau spyo he/ sh+lau hūṃ ho phaṭa haṃ/ zhes brjod de me tog gi tshom bu bkod de de lta bu'i sku'am sngags gang

rgyud r+pā gsalobar byed pa'i thig le 47yang rung bar mos pa bya'o/ /de nas me tog dmar po mchod par bya/ /zhes pas me tog la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa dang / gzugs la sogs pa nang gi mchod pa dang / tshogs dang bdud rtsi la sogs pa gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal dang lag pa'i lha rnams rang la bsdus la thim pas gnyis su med par bsam mo/ /da ni gzungs kyi cho ga bstan pa'i phyir/rin chen snod bzang zlo gyis mdzes/ /zhes gsungs pas/ zangs la sogasabe+e 'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du/ sman dang rin po che la sogs pa'i lnga tshan lnga'i bum rdzas blugs kha rgyan mags rgyan gyis legs par brgyan la/ sro(ga chags med pa'i chu yis legs par bkang la maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bzhag la/ zlo las gzhal yas khang du bskyed/ de'i lte ba la sna tshogs pad+ma dang / nyi me'i dkyil 'bor gyi steng du he ru ka yab yum du bskyed/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bsam mo/ /dpa' bo bdud rtsi dag byed chu/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bdag nyid he ru ka'i rnal 'gror du gsal bas sa bon la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar dmigs te/ gzungs thag la 'khril zhing

48 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thigale song bas/ tha ma he ru ka yab yum bdud rtsi zhu ba'i chu des bkrus na nad dang gdon la sku(gas pa'i nyes pa thams cad dag par 'gyur ro/ /da ni bar chad bsrung ba dang gnodi pa gsal ba la sku(gas pa bstan pa'i phyir/zhal bzhi'i sngags kyi 'od zer gyis/ /zhes bya ba ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ grohā grohā hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ grod+dhā pa ya grohā pa ya ghu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho r+bha ga wān badz+ra rā dzā hūṃ ṇ+ḍaṃ phaṭa/ zhes yab yum gyi snying po dang spel ba'o/ /gdug pa ma lus kun 'dul zhing / /zhes pa ni/ pha rol gyi rig sngags bzlog pa dang / nad dang gnod pa la sogs pa dang / smyo 'dul ba dang / ser ba bzlog pa la sogs pa'o/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i rnam pa can/ /zhes pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje dang // pad+ma dang / 'khor lo'i gur khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bsrung bya rang nyid 'khor dang bcas pa lha'i rnal 'gyor du gsal btab la/ sngags bzlas pas 'khor lo 'khor zhing 'od zer rnams kyang tsha tsha lta bu 'phros pas/ phas kyi rbad 'dre dang / rbede gtong dang gdug pa thams cad btul nas tshur 'dus pas sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa'i 'khor 'osgo la thim pa gsal gdab par

rgyud don gsalabar byed pa'i thig le 49bsam zhing bzlas pa bya'o/ /gnode pa bsal ba ni/ rang gzhan gyi lus la nad dang gnod pa yod na bdag nyid he ru kar gnas pa'i thugs ka'i hūṃlas ye shes kyi me 'bar bas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad sbyangs te/ ye shes kyi skur gyur par bsam/ gang na gnod pa yodi pa'i sar he ru ka'i ngo bo hūṃ las me 'bar ba re re bzhugs par bsgoms la sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /smyo 'dul bar 'dod na/ dang po bgegs la zhi bas bka' bsgo'o//de nas yungs kar dang lcags phye dang / rdo phye rnams khrag dang dug gi chus sbag la rtsa ba'i snying po la zhal bzhi pa'i sngags btags ste bzlas pas /thun de rnams khro bo gnod mdzes kyi rang bzhin khro tsho rdo rje rtse dgu pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa me 'bar ba re re gyur par bsam zhing bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'gyor du gsal bas thun de dag gang la brab pa'i gdug pa thams cad 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /srung skud byed par 'dod na/ gong gi sngags la lnga sgril lam sum sgril du byas la rak+ṣa btags te bzlas par bya zhing mdud pa la swa bhā was stong par bsgoms te/ de nas hūṃ las he ru ka yab yum du bskyed pa'i thugs kar bsrung bya bcug la/ snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bsams la/ rten 'brel gyi snying

50 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le yos rab gnas byas te/ gang la btags pa de'i gnod pa thams cad bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ / da ni mngon spyodad kyi las gdug pa can bsgral ba'i thabs mkha' 'gro ma drug gi sgrub pa bstan pa'i phyir/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das skye mched kyi mkha' 'dzato ma gang lags/ zhes zhus pas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ba/jil pa/ gcer bu thal ba'i mdog can te/ /zhes bya ba ni/ mkha' 'grerdzo ma drug po sku gcer bu mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa rgyan med pa thal chen gyis lus byugs pa drug bordzo/ / nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul rnams 'grims/ /zhes bya ba ni gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang / zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang /tshan dho dang nye ba'i tshan dho dang / 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba can/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod rnams su rgyu'o/ /lnga pa dang ni drug pa 'o/ /zhes pa ni/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du khams kyi lha mo lnga dang / de'i chos nyid rdo rje rnal 'gyor ma dang drug yin la/ 'dir mngon spyod kyi 'phrin las sgrub par byed pa 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma bsgrub par bya'o/ /

rgyud don gsalobar byed pa'i thig le 5 de dag gi sngags dang mchod pa'i thabs bstan pa'i phyir/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de'i sngags gang lags/ gtor ma gang lags zhes zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ tshun dz+wa la mu khri ni la sku(gas pa'i sngags drug gi thugs dam bskul bar byed pa ste rgyud na gsal lo/ /mchod pa'i thabs ni/ chu skyes dag gis rnam brgyan cing / /zhes gsungs pas/ pad+ma'i snod dag pa kha'i nang du gri snying rtsa lag ma nyams pa chang bu brdar zhing mchod pa dang /bdud rtsi lnga yi rnam par mdzes/ /zhes pas sha lnga dang bdud rtsilngas brgyan pa'i gtore ma byin gyis brlabs te dbul bar bya'o/ /dpa' mo drug gis mnyes par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ni/ dz+wa la mu khri la sku(gas pa mkha' 'grerdzo ma drug mnyes nas phrin las bsgrurbe par bya'o/ /de ni rgyal yo la sogs pa dbang du bya ba'i phyir tshogs kyi bdag po'i bsgrub pa bstan pa'i phyir te/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam pa'i ngo bo ni gang lags/ sgrub pa'i ngo bo ni gang lags/ zhes zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/

52 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thig le rnam pa'i ngo bo lha nyid de/ /zhes bya ba ni/ chos nyid 'od gsal ba'i ngang las skad cig gis bskyed pa'i rang nyid he ru ka'i skur gnas pa'o/ /sprul pa tshogs kyi bdag por bshad/ /ces bya ba ni/ dbang gi las sgrub par byed pa'i lha tshogs kyi bdag po'o/ /de'i bsnyen sgrub rgyas par bstan pa'i phyir/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das tshogs kyi bdag po gang lags zhes zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ba34la pa/dbang gi kha dog dmar po ste/ /zhes pa ni sku mdog go/ /zhal bcug pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /zhes pa ni/ zhal glang ngo che'i sna can phyag g.yas na la phug dang dgra sta/ g.yon la du'i snedi dang phreng ba bsnams pa'o/ /sprul pa 'khor lo'i rtsibs la gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad la sprul pa'i tshogs bdag brgyad bzhugs pa/ kha nang du blta ba dngos grub gter ba'i tshul 'ordzo/ /brkyang bskum tshul gyis mnan pa'o/ /zhes bya ba ni/ zhabs brkyang bskum du bzhugs pas rin po che'i gter gyi

rgyud don gsalobar byed pa'i thig le 53bum pa mnan pa'o/ /de nas yang rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bsnyen pa bya ba gang lags zhus pas/ bcermem ldan 'das kyis bka' brgyujil pa/bsnyen pa bya ba sngags nyid de/ /zhes bya ba ni/ nye ba'i snying po ste go sla'o/ /las la sbyor ba'i sgrub pa ni gya brgyad pa'o/ /rdzas ni/nag pe rdzo'agru yi ril bu la/ /zhes pa sran ma'o/ /bsnyen dang sgrub pa lhar gnas pa/ / zhes pa ni/ de ltar lhar bskyed cing sngags bzlas pa'o/ /sngags kyi ngo bo shes par bya/ /zhes pa ni/ tshogs bdag dngos su bskyed pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /de dag gi ngag rnam par dag pa sngags kyi rim pa bstan pa ste le'u gsum pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //da ni rgyud yongs su rdzogs pa'i don rjes su yi rang ba bstan pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das kyi de skad ces bka' bstsal pa dang / zhes pa ni rgyud 'di nyid do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po dang / zhes pa ni phyag na rdo rje'o/ /rdo rje gnod gnas la sogs pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams so/ /rnal 'gyor ma dpag tu med pa ni/

54 rgyud don gsal bar byed pa'i thigale ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gyo ma thams cad do/ /'khor de dag rjes su yi rang ba ni/ rab tu dga' zhing yid ches par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //rgyud don gsal ba dri med rdo rje'i tshig /gsal ba rnam 'byed zab mo bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /ma rig mun sel rta bdun 'dzin pa'i 'od/ /rin chen brgyud pa'i gsung don gser 'gyur rtsi/ /bskosnad pa las byung dge ba gang sku(da des/ /'gro kun rnam grol he ru ka thob shog /snyan rgyud bkod dang nor 'khrul dri ma rnams/ /yi dam mkha' 'a〈sna rnams kyis bzod par bzhes/ /byin rlabs spyostu spyod dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i man ngag gi 'grel pa bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //bhik+ṣu badz+ra rā dzā yis/ / phugs su ma bzhag mngon du bkod/ /dri med rgyud kyi yang snying 'dis/ /'gro kun he ru ka thob shog / maṅga lam̐//

rgyud don gsawobar byed pa'i thig le 55lto/ dus khrugs zhi zhing bod yul bde ba'i spyod lam bzhugs// lto/ skyabs gnas bslumed dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum/ /khyad par gangs can mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /rje btsun sgrol ma gu ru pad+ma 'byung / /gsol ba 'debs so thugs dam zhal bzhes dgongs/ /smone lam yongs su 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /snyigs dus 'gro rnams bsam sbyor 'ordzog pa dang / /phyi nang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis//sngar ma grags pa'i mi phyugs dal yams nad/ /gza' klu rgyal gdoni nag phyogs 'byung po'i zer/ /btsa' sad ser gsum lo nyes dmag 'khrug rtsod/ /char chu mi snyoms gangs chen bra byi'i than/ /sa g.yos me dgra 'byung bzhi'i 'jigs pa dang / /khyad par bstan la 'tshe ba'i mtha' dmag sogs/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir gnod 'tshe'i rigs tha dag /myur du zhi zhing rtsad nas 'joms gyur cig /mi dang mi min 'gro ba mtha' dag gi//rgyud la byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ /ngang gis skyes nas gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor bral/ /phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang ldan nas kyang //bod yul mtha' dbus bde skyid dpal gyis 'gror/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas rbesgog /rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i

56 smon lam bcas byon/stosnabs/ /'khor 'das dge ba'i rtsa ba gang mchis dang / /bdag cag lha bsam rnam par dkar ba'i mthus/ /gserdzol btab spyod pa'i 'bras bu 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang sgoms las pa blo gros mtha' yas kyis tsā 'dra rin chen brag tu rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs 'grub pa'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i snga dre'i char rang gi bsgel gsos su bris pa ji bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ //7/ bdag gi dus gsum dge ba 'di dag gis/ /sdig dang sgrib pa ma lus zad byas te/ /rtag par dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung nas/ /tshul gnas thos bsam 〉(ma pa mthar phyin 3(ga /smin byed dbang thob rim gnyis zung 'jug gis/ kho rlung thig le sbyangs nas dwangs ma'i lus/ /nges par skye ba gcig gis 'grub gyur te/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang sa la gnas par shog /'di nas bzung ste skye dang skye ba ru/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyi mgoni dang skyabs/ /lam stoni dge ba'i bshes su bdag gyur nas/ /ma lus rnam grol mchog la 'god par 3snag /gong ma'i gdan sa dben pa'i gnas/ /rtag tu ri khrod 'grim byed cing / /rtogs pa skyong zhing smon lam 'debs/ /brgyud pa'i srol ka 'dzin par shog / myo/ de ltar rgyud kyi rtsa 'grel 'di bzhin/ bal yul 'phags pa shing kunashrī rgo tam bud+dha wi ha ra'i gsung rab rgyun spel khang nas par gzhi bsgrigasapa lags so// dge'o//
